objective: Audit the pinned StarEmbed ZTF_40k source splits and test whether the frozen v0.2.0 42-feature input path can process a deterministic clean subset without training or predicting.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Issue #210 and PR #211 recorded one duplicate SourceID within the StarEmbed train split and one train/test SourceID overlap; source lineage and split-generation semantics remain unresolved.
StarEmbed has a seven-class taxonomy and is not mapped to the frozen 15-class v0.2.0 production taxonomy.
The experiment is input compatibility only. It must not report model accuracy or alter the v0.2.0 model, features, class order, benchmark, or acceptance criteria.
The initial PR #290 CI run 43684816288 failed Ruff because star_embed_input.py had a missing comma and skipped downstream stages.
The same initial workflow contained doubled shell continuation characters in the pytest and acquisition-manifest checks; the pytest command could pass a literal backslash argument.

baseline.model: Frozen v0.2.0 feature extractor only; no model inference

sample.policy: exclude duplicated test IDs and IDs overlapping any other split

change.proposed: Repair the Python syntax defect and shell line continuations, then run the pinned StarEmbed source integrity audit and deterministic 50-object feature-input probe.
change.scope: Research branch only: dedicated workflow, source audit, input adapter, focused tests and this lifecycle record. No production or frozen baseline changes.
change.rationale: The earlier CI failure was an engineering defect that prevented the independent-input experiment from running. It must be repaired before interpreting any StarEmbed evidence.

expected_improvement: Run focused unit tests for StarEmbed schema mapping, source split integrity and feature output.
Verify the five pinned Parquet files and their hashes.
Report duplicate IDs and cross-split overlaps without weakening fail-closed behavior.
Generate up to 50 deterministic clean-test feature vectors in the frozen v0.2.0 feature order.
Keep all StarEmbed classifier-performance claims out of scope.

reliability.before: CI run 43684816288 failed at Ruff lint due to a syntax error in star_embed_input.py; downstream test, build and dependency stages were skipped.
reliability.after: Format Check and Lint passed on commit 3ef4682f4f3ee75d796cde46995fd036cc662fb1. Cumulative Lifecycle Gate failed because this meaningful PR change had no cycle record. A new cycle record is being added; fresh CI is required.

correctness.before: The feature-input module had a Python syntax error, and workflow shell continuations were malformed.
correctness.after: The missing list-item comma was corrected. Two doubled shell continuation characters were reduced to one. The corrected commands are visible in the PR head; focused tests and the source-backed probe have not yet run on the corrected head.

reproducibility.before: The PR defines a pinned source manifest and deterministic seed, but no successful current-head acquisition artifact has been inspected.
reproducibility.after: Pending fresh source-backed workflow execution and artifact hash verification.

evidence: CodeQL, Product Scope Audit and Scientific Validation passed on commit 3ef4682f4f3ee75d796cde46995fd036cc662fb1.
Format Check and Ruff Lint passed on CI run 43815904979.
The Cumulative Lifecycle Gate failed because the PR did not include a machine-readable cycle record.
The test suite, package build, dependency audit and StarEmbed acquisition workflow have not yet completed on the corrected head.

PR #290 is now stacked on security/soupsieve-cve-20261114 (PR #289), whose complete CI including Dependency Audit passed. A fresh PR #290 run on this base is required; the previous Dependency Audit failure was against main's soupsieve==2.10.
validation.blocker: Run fresh CI and the dedicated source-backed StarEmbed audit on the current PR head with the PR #289 security base. Inspect the source audit and feature-input artifacts.

root_causes: The initial Ruff failure was caused by a missing comma between adjacent string literals in the limitations list in star_embed_input.py.
The workflow's pytest and acquisition-manifest shell commands contained two trailing backslashes instead of one, so shell continuation semantics were incorrect.
The corrected PR head then failed the lifecycle gate because the meaningful code/workflow changes did not include a cumulative cycle record.
limitations: The source dataset has known duplicate and cross-split overlap risks; these remain scientific benchmark blockers.
A successful feature-input probe does not establish classifier accuracy, taxonomy compatibility or independent scientific validation.
The 50-object sample is diagnostic and cannot establish population-level performance.
No production model inference or training is in scope.

findings: A code-level feature-input compatibility test must be separated from benchmark-label and classifier-performance validation.
Split-level duplicate and overlap checks must remain fail-closed.
Lifecycle records are required for meaningful PR changes and must state unverified work explicitly.

open_blockers: Rerun full CI after this cycle record is committed.
Verify focused tests pass on the corrected PR head.
Verify the dedicated StarEmbed workflow runs its pytest command and checks the acquisition manifest.
Inspect the acquired source audit report and exact duplicate/overlap IDs.
Inspect the 50-object input probe and confirm the feature width/order and all per-object failures.
Do not claim benchmark acceptance while any source split duplicate or cross-split overlap remains unexplained.
Fresh CI after retargeting PR #290 to the verified PR #289 security branch; confirm the complete Dependency Audit passes.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not train or run predictions on StarEmbed as if its seven classes map to the frozen 15-class production taxonomy.
Do not weaken duplicate or cross-split leakage checks.
Do not change the v0.2.0 feature definitions, model artifact, class order or benchmark.
Do not claim the 50-object probe completed until the source-backed artifact is inspected.
Keep PR #290 Draft until all engineering and source-backed evidence is reviewed.
PR #290 is stacked on PR #289; do not merge the experiment before the security base is accepted.
